purpose: Qualify a narrowly observed AC1024 inline SAB 21500 zero-record-count framing profile and validate its bounded SAT v1 projection against independent readers and a non-OCCT kernel primitive.

thirdHeaderInteger.semantics: Unqualified for this ACIS 21500 profile; do not relabel as a body count.

implementation.framing: Version-scoped zero record counts are admitted for ACIS 21200, 21500 and 21800 only when the complete explicit terminal marker is present.
implementation.satProjection: For ACIS 21200/21500 sources, SAT v1 output uses the parsed nonterminal record count. AC1024+ history output is normalized to the source flags' bit 0. ACIS 21500 Unknown0x17 carries an eight-byte double and is emitted as a numeric SAT token.
implementation.scopeLimit: No additional 21500 record layouts, modeler associations, DXF/DWG output routes, or support claims are inferred from this selected solid.

localReaderResult.command: A scratch inspector linked against build-gcc/libdxfrw.a called drw_parseSabWithOutcome, drw_buildAcisModel, drw_extractAcisWireframe, and drw_convertSabToSatV1 on the exact selected SAB.

projection.claimLimit: Inventory projection only; it does not establish body/shell/loop incidence closure, B-rep validity, or native CAD meaning.

operations.result: 115 nonterminal records; record-type histogram agrees with the libdxfrw parse.

ACIS 215.0; SAT header values are version 21500, 115 records, third integer 2, flags 0; ACadRust exposes the third integer through its num_bodies field, but this does not establish ACIS 21500 semantics or body-record correspondence. The parsed record-type histogram agrees with the source SAB parse.

independentReader.semanticLimit: This is independent ACIS record parsing, not a B-rep kernel or native CAD application acceptance.

independentKernel.operation: Read the eight point records from the exact SAT projection with ACadRust; construct an OpenCADKernel cuboid from their min/max coordinates.
independentKernel.claimLimit: The kernel constructed a cuboid from source-derived points; it did not lift the SAT face/edge/coedge graph. This is not a direct SAT-to-B-rep interoperability result.

unresolved: Establish the ACIS 21500 third-header-integer semantics and reconcile its value with a complete top-level record census using version-qualified evidence.
Prove source body/lump/shell/face/loop/coedge incidence and orientation closure against a direct non-OCCT SAT-to-B-rep lift.
FreeCAD 1.1.4 console Part.insert rejected the SAT extension as unknown; ImportGui is unavailable in the console application. Native FreeCAD acceptance remains unqualified.
ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0 aborted before reading the file because macOS PasteBoard services were unavailable; no conversion evidence was produced.
No whole-source DWG/DXF graph, other AC1024 producers, or broad 3D support claim is qualified.

validation.generatedControl: The allocation test now covers generated ACIS 21500 zero-count framing, numeric Unknown0x17 double serialization, SAT record-count output and history-bit normalization, in addition to its existing 21200 allocation-failure rollback/retry sweep.
validation.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was committed; the sample and all probes remain in local or temporary paths.

claimEffect: A bounded AC1024 ACIS 21500 framing and SAT projection gap is closed for the selected profile. Record parsing and source-point primitive comparison improve implementation evidence only; version-specific header semantics, full source B-rep lift, native acceptance, graph/output closure and support qualification remain open.

headerSemanticsReview.odaDwgSpec: Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.41 says detailed ACIS/SAB data is outside its scope; it does not define the third SAB header integer for this profile.

independentReferences.source: CADMPEG ASM format documentation, ACIS 217/218 BinaryFile header
independentReferences.finding: Documents an entity-count word in the ACIS 217/218 31-byte header, but its stated record-table semantics are not established for ACIS 21500.
Parses the third SAT header integer into a num_bodies field; this parser interpretation alone does not prove the 21500 SAB producer semantics.

headerSemanticsReview.conclusion: The former two-bodies-versus-one-body discrepancy was an unsupported relabeling of numEntities. Preserve the raw field value and observed body-record census separately until eligible version-specific evidence establishes their relationship.
